mainEntity.name: What are the common building codes for tiny homes in Oceanside?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Oceanside, tiny homes typically fall under specific zoning and building codes depending on whether they are considered Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs), Junior Accessory Dwelling Units (JADUs), or Recreational Vehicles (RVs). ADUs and JADUs must comply with residential building codes, including foundation requirements, utility connections, and minimum square footage. RVs are subject to different regulations, often related to temporary parking. We recommend reviewing the City of Oceanside's planning department guidelines or consulting with us for current and specific requirements for your tiny home project.
